items.title: Qoñyr: The Archive of Silence, 61st Venice Biennale, Kazakhstan Pavilion (sound work Dübir; Steppe Architectonics)

items.text: Astana collective of five artists (Gulmaral Tattibayeva, Beibit Asemkul, Natalia Ligay, Aliya Kanibekova, Zhenis Moldabekov), exhibiting since 2011 and earlier known as Cadmium Red (Kadmii Qyzyl); curator and consultant Vladislav Sludsky. Tattibayeva is a member of the Union of Artists of Kazakhstan.
